race.comment: SHOOTING BRAKE (9) presents third up here off two good runs this time in against stronger company. He was close up fresh in a bunched finish in town before tackling the Listed McKenzie Stakes and battling on well behind Blind Raise who is now Caulfield Guineas favourite. Finds a nice race now and should go close. RANARSSON (8) is a well-bred colt by Ole Kirk who was a $700,000 yearling purchase for the Hayes yard. He's jumped out very well and should take some beating. PURSUIT (14) resumes having just found one better on debut at Geelong in a good effort. Can improve this time around and go one better. KOTAHITANGA (3) gelding by Tassort who was a NZD $ 250,000 (NZB 2025 Ready to Run Sale) yearling and is on debut. Was out of the placings at his most recent trial. Watch for any market confidence.
